children: Nine of the 10 best-performing S&P 500 stocks over the past decade were tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure, led by Nvidia, whose 10-year total return was near 13,589%, according to BeInCrypto, more than double AMD’s close to 6,000%. The other names included Micron, Comfort Systems, Arista Networks, Lam Research, Tesla, Lumentum, KLA Corp and Seagate, spanning chips, networking, storage and data-center cooling.

title: Nvidia Tops S&P 500’s Best Performers As AI Infrastructure Drives Gains
